description: Defines the URLRequestThrottlerEntry class, which manages request throttling logic including back-off algorithms and request rate limiting for URL requests within the Chromium project.

classes.name: URLRequestThrottlerEntry
classes.description: Manages request rate limiting and back-off logic for URL requests, including exponential back-off and sliding window request counting.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request should be rejected based on current throttling state.

methods.name: ReserveSendingTimeForNextRequest
methods.description: Reserves a time slot for the next request, considering back-off and rate limits.

methods.name: GetExponentialBackoffReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the back-off period ends, allowing requests to be sent again.

methods.name: UpdateWithResponse
methods.description: Updates throttling state based on the response status code.

methods.name: ReceivedContentWasMalformed
methods.description: Increments error count when response content is malformed, affecting back-off calculations.

methods.name: DisableBackoffThrottling
methods.description: Disables back-off, allowing requests to proceed without delay.

methods.name: DetachManager
methods.description: Detaches the entry from its managing object.
